definition_en: to judge how good, large or serious something is

examples.supportive: Teachers assess each student and give a careful mark.
examples.neutral: The team will assess the plan.

items: The doctor will ____ how serious the injury is.
We need to ____ the risk before we start.
Every year the school will ____ its own progress.
he_interference_note: «להעריך» בעברית מכסה גם assess, גם estimate וגם appreciate. דובר עברית שמתכוון «אני מעריך אותך» כותב I assess you במקום I appreciate you.

definition_en: something that stops people or things from passing

examples.supportive: The police put a barrier across the road to stop cars.

items: A tall ____ keeps the animals inside the field.
Language can be a ____ between people from other countries.
The workers put a ____ around the deep hole.

definition_en: to get something useful or helpful from something

examples.supportive: Poor families benefit from the new law and pay less.

items: Students who read a lot ____ from it later.
The whole town will ____ from the new bridge.
The company will ____ if more people buy its goods.

definition_en: a person who works with you

examples.supportive: My colleague at the office helps me with hard tasks.

items: She asked a ____ in her office for advice.
Every ____ on the team came to the meeting.
He shared the news with a ____ he trusts.

definition_en: to agree to accept less than you first wanted

examples.supportive: Both sides must compromise if they want to end the fight.

items: If neither side will ____ the talks will fail.
Leaders must ____ to reach an agreement that both accept.
She refused to ____ on the price of the house.

definition_en: to ask a person or a book for advice or information

examples.supportive: Always consult a doctor before you take a new medicine.

items: Please ____ the map before you drive to the farm.
The manager will ____ his team about the new plan.
You must ____ a lawyer before you sign this paper.

definition_en: to change something into a different form or use

examples.supportive: They will convert the old factory into a school for children.

items: The bank can ____ your money into another currency.
He wants to ____ the old shop into a small office.
This machine will ____ heat into power.

definition_en: to deal with a hard problem in a successful way

examples.supportive: She learned to cope with the pain after the accident.

items: New parents must ____ with very little sleep.
The small shop could not ____ with so many orders.
It is not easy to ____ with such a heavy load.

definition_en: extremely important because other things depend on it

examples.supportive: Sleep is crucial for health; without it we cannot work well.

items: Water is ____ for every living thing on earth.
This meeting is ____ to the future of the company.
Money was ____ in getting the project finished on time.

definition_en: to become smaller or worse over a period of time

examples.supportive: Sales began to decline and the shop lost much money.

items: The number of birds here will slowly ____ each year.
Prices will ____ when more goods reach the market.
His health started to ____ after the long illness.
he_interference_note: «לרדת» מכסה גם go down, גם get off וגם decline. דובר עברית כותב the prices went down כשהמשלב מחייב prices declined.

definition_en: to politely refuse an offer or an invitation

examples.supportive: He had to decline the invitation because he was busy.

items: He chose to ____ their kind offer of help.
It is better to ____ an offer with a friendly note.
She will ____ the job because the pay is too low.

definition_en: to officially remove a worker from a job

examples.supportive: The company will dismiss many workers to save money.

items: The boss will ____ him at the end of the month.
It is not easy to ____ a worker without a clear reason.
They had to ____ the driver after the second accident.

definition_en: to be greater than a fixed number or limit

examples.supportive: The cost must not exceed the limit that we agreed.

items: Do not ____ the speed limit on this narrow road.
Sales this year will ____ the total of last year.
The noise must not ____ the level set by law.

definition_en: to promise firmly that something will certainly happen

examples.supportive: We guarantee that your money comes back if the goods break.

items: Hard work alone cannot ____ success in every field.
The shop will ____ that the radio works for a whole year.
No one can ____ that the weather will stay dry.
he_interference_note: «להבטיח» מכסה גם promise, גם guarantee וגם ensure. דובר עברית כותב the shop promises the radio for a whole year במקום guarantees.

definition_en: damage or injury caused to a person or a thing

examples.supportive: Smoking does great harm to the body over many years.

items: The storm did little ____ to the old stone wall.
Too much sun can do real ____ to your skin.
He meant no ____ when he made that joke.

definition_en: to force a rule, tax or punishment on people

examples.supportive: The government will impose a new tax on cheap goods.

items: The court can ____ a heavy fine on the driver.
Schools should not ____ rules that no one understands.
The new law will ____ a limit on working hours.

definition_en: to show that something is right or reasonable

examples.supportive: Nothing can justify such hard treatment of young children.

items: How can you ____ spending so much on one meal?
The results ____ the long hours we spent on this.
Nothing can ____ the way he treats his mother.

definition_en: the failure to care for someone or something properly

examples.supportive: Years of neglect left the old house cold and empty.

items: The plants dried up from ____ while the family was away.
The report blamed the accident on ____ of safety rules.
Such ____ of a young child is against the law.

definition_en: something that you must do because of a law or promise

examples.supportive: Parents have a legal obligation to send their children to school.

items: You are under no ____ to buy anything today.
The company failed to meet its ____ to pay on time.
Every citizen has an ____ to follow the law.

definition_en: a person who plays or fights against you in a contest

examples.supportive: She beat her opponent in the final game of the match.

items: He lost to a stronger ____ in the last round.
A strong ____ makes the game much more interesting.
The young player faced an older ____ in the first round.

definition_en: the result of an action, meeting or process

examples.supportive: Nobody could guess the outcome of the long trial.

items: We must wait for the ____ before we decide.
The ____ of the vote was a clear win for the young leader.
Both teams accepted the ____ of the game without argument.
he_interference_note: «תוצאה» מכסה גם result, גם outcome וגם consequence. בהקשר של תהליך או משא ומתן האנגלית מעדיפה outcome, ודובר עברית יכתוב result תמיד.

definition_en: a punishment given for breaking a rule or law

examples.supportive: The penalty for driving too fast is a large fine.

items: There is a heavy ____ for anyone who breaks this rule.
The court set a small ____ because he was young.
Late payment brings an extra ____ each month.

definition_en: to become aware of something through the senses or the mind

examples.supportive: We perceive the world through our eyes and ears.

items: Animals can ____ danger long before we do.
Most people ____ him to be a kind and honest man.
It is hard to ____ any change in the light.
he_interference_note: «להבחין» מכסה גם notice, גם distinguish וגם perceive. התרגום כאן אינו חד־חד ערכי ולכן סומן כטרם אומת.

definition_en: to say that someone or something is very good

examples.supportive: The teacher will praise students who try hard in class.

items: Critics ____ the new film for its beautiful pictures.
Do not forget to ____ a child who does well.
The manager will ____ the team in front of everyone.

definition_en: something that must be dealt with before other things

examples.supportive: Safety is our first priority; everything else can wait.

items: Health must be the top ____ for any government.
Give ____ to the jobs that cannot wait.
Her family is her highest ____.

definition_en: closely connected with the subject that is being discussed

examples.supportive: Please keep to the point and give only relevant facts.

items: The judge asked for all ____ papers from both sides.
Your answer is interesting but it is not ____ here.
Only ____ experience counts for this job.

definition_en: to leave your job by your own choice

examples.supportive: The minister will resign and leave the government next week.

items: She plans to ____ from her post at the end of the year.
If the team keeps losing the coach may ____ his post.
He chose to ____ his position rather than accept the new rules.

definition_en: to change something to the opposite of what it was

examples.supportive: The new leader will reverse the decision about the old law.

items: A court can ____ a decision if new facts appear.
Nothing can ____ the damage in the forest.
The company hopes to ____ the fall in sales.
he_interference_note: «להפוך» מכסה גם turn over, גם become וגם reverse. ההתלבטות כאן היא בין «להפוך» ל«לבטל» בהקשר של החלטה, ולכן סומן כטרם אומת.

definition_en: to say that you will hurt or punish someone

examples.supportive: He began to threaten the boy in the street.

items: The men ____ to burn the shop if she calls the police.
Do not ____ a child who is already afraid.
Some workers ____ to stop work over low pay.

definition_en: absolutely necessary for something to succeed or survive

examples.supportive: Clean water is vital; people cannot live without it.

items: Fresh air is ____ for good health.
It is ____ that everyone knows the safety rules.
The heart plays a ____ part in the body.

definition_en: to take money out of a bank account

examples.supportive: You can withdraw cash from the machine near the bank.

items: He went to the bank to ____ money for the trip.
You may ____ only a small sum each day.
She had to ____ some money to pay the doctor.
he_interference_note: «למשוך» מכסה גם pull, גם draw, גם attract וגם withdraw. דובר עברית כותב pull money from the bank.

definition_en: to move back or leave a place, group or contest

examples.supportive: The army will withdraw from the town before winter.

items: The runner had to ____ from the race because of pain.
Both sides agreed to ____ their soldiers from the border.
He may ____ his name from the list of players.

definition_en: something good that you succeed in doing after effort

examples.supportive: Winning the prize was her greatest achievement so far.

items: Landing on the moon was a huge ____ for science.
The award marks his ____ in medicine.
Learning a new language is a real ____ at any age.

definition_en: to accept or admit that something is true

examples.supportive: He was ready to acknowledge his own mistake.

items: The company must ____ that its goods were not safe.
She refused to ____ the truth about her health.
Few leaders ____ their own errors in public.
he_interference_note: «להודות» מכסה גם thank וגם admit. דובר עברית כותב I acknowledge you for the gift במקום I thank you.

definition_en: to get or gain something such as a skill or property

examples.supportive: Children acquire language quickly when they hear it daily.

items: The company hopes to ____ several smaller firms this year.
It takes years to ____ such a skill.
He worked hard to ____ enough land for a farm.
he_interference_note: «לרכוש» מכסה גם buy וגם acquire. דובר עברית כותב buy a skill במקום acquire a skill.

definition_en: to plan and organise an event or a meeting

examples.supportive: Let us arrange a meeting for next week at the office.

items: Can you ____ a taxi for me tomorrow?
The school will ____ a trip to the museum.
We must ____ the details of the wedding soon.

definition_en: to act in a particular way towards other people

examples.supportive: Children behave better when the rules are clear.

items: Try to ____ well while we are in the shop.
He tends to ____ badly when he is tired.
Animals ____ in strange ways before a storm.

definition_en: a strong feeling that something is true or real

examples.supportive: Her belief in God helps her through hard times.

items: There is a common ____ that money brings happiness.
Nothing could shake his ____ in his own son.
It is my ____ that everyone deserves a fair chance.

definition_en: a feeling that you can do things well and succeed

examples.supportive: Practice gives a young player confidence in every game.

items: Kind words help to build ____ in young children.
She lost all ____ after the failure.
He answered every question with quiet ____.
he_interference_note: «ביטחון» מכסה גם security, גם safety וגם confidence. דובר עברית כותב he has security in himself במקום confidence.

definition_en: to have earned something by your actions or qualities

examples.supportive: After all that hard work you deserve a long rest.

items: Such a poor answer does not ____ a reply.
Those students ____ a prize for their fine work.
Nobody should ____ to be treated like that.
he_interference_note: בעברית אומרים «מגיע לי», ולכן דובר עברית כותב it arrives to me או I have coming במקום I deserve it.

definition_en: to pause before doing something because you are unsure

examples.supportive: She began to hesitate before she opened the dark door.

items: Do not ____ to ask for help if you need it.
He tends to ____ before he answers a hard question.
If you ____ too long the chance will pass.

definition_en: to pay no attention to a person or a fact

examples.supportive: Do not ignore the warning signs on the road.

items: It is wrong to ____ a friend who needs help.
The driver chose to ____ the red light.
We cannot ____ these facts any longer.
he_interference_note: בעברית «להתעלם» דורש מילת יחס (מ־), ולכן דובר עברית כותב ignore from the problem במקום ignore the problem.

definition_en: to say firmly that something must happen or is true

examples.supportive: She will insist that we all wear a coat.

items: He will ____ on paying for the whole meal.
The doctors ____ that she must rest for a month.
They ____ on strict rules for every guest.

definition_en: easy to see or understand without any doubt

examples.supportive: The answer was obvious to everyone in the room.

items: It was ____ that he had not read the book.
There is no ____ reason for the delay.
The mistake was ____ as soon as we looked.

definition_en: lasting for a very long time or for ever

examples.supportive: She wants a permanent job and not a short one.

items: The damage to the wall is ____ and cannot be fixed.
They are looking for a ____ home in the country.
This is only a test and not a ____ rule.
he_interference_note: «קבוע» מכסה גם fixed, גם regular וגם permanent. דובר עברית כותב a regular job כשהכוונה a permanent job.

definition_en: to make someone agree to do something by talking to them

examples.supportive: He tried to persuade her to stay one more day.

items: We could not ____ him to change his mind.
She used facts to ____ the class that she was right.
Nothing will ____ me to drive on that road again.

definition_en: able to be trusted to do what is needed

examples.supportive: He is a reliable worker who always comes on time.

items: We need a ____ person to look after the money.
This is the most ____ way to reach the town.
Old machines are less ____ than new ones.
